canonical_source_note: There is no simulate_intervention.py in this repository. api/scorer.py states logic was lifted from simulate_intervention.py and implements a 2-term API fallback (0.60 * tcell_gps - 0.40 * stromal_arm) when the myeloid panel is unavailable. The filing-grade 3-module construction is exactly as in run_artistry7_proxy_pipeline.py (lines shown below).
weights_note: Effective per-gene contribution when the full gene panel is present: module_weight * (1 / n_genes_present_in_module). TCELL_GPS uses +0.40/n; MYELOID_FLOOD uses -0.35/n; STROMAL_CAGE uses -0.25/n. Missing genes are dropped from the mean inside _signature_score (not renormalized in code).
threshold_derivation: Hardcoded narrative gate in api/sequence_engine.py (intervention path conditions use IMMUNE_ACCESS_SCORE > 0.40). No in-repository Kaplan–Meier or percentile optimization was found tying 0.40 to pooled MetaGx survival; it is a design constant for the sequencing/pembrolizumab checkpoint copy, not a data-derived cutoff on IMMUNE_ACCESS_SCORE itself.
OS_separation_HR_model: Univariate Cox proportional hazards; covariate hi=1 if IMMUNE_ACCESS_SCORE > 0.40 else 0; HR is exp(beta_hi) for death hazard comparing high vs low arm.
dataset_used: TCGA-OV artistry7_proxy: inner-join of data/artistry7_proxy/tme_scores.csv with data/artistry7_proxy/ovarian_raw.csv on SAMPLE_ID; OS_EVENT derived from OS_STATUS (1:DECEASED -> 1, else 0); rows with OS_MONTHS > 0; n=426.
